rules.name: opens the menu on a pointer click and leaves focus on the trigger
rules.source: Dropdown.svelte (toggle, keydown, focusBy, close, outside, focusout, left), menu.ts (menuOpening), roving.ts (menuMove, landOn)
rules.note: The menu is a manual popover shown with showPopover(); its place is written to --menu-top, --menu-left, --menu-anchor-width and --menu-max-width and follows scroll and resize.

rules.name: opens the menu and focuses the first item on a keyboard click
rules.source: Dropdown.svelte (toggle, keydown, focusBy, close, outside, focusout, left), menu.ts (menuOpening), roving.ts (menuMove, landOn)
rules.note: Enter and Space on the trigger fire a click with detail 0. The first .dropdown-item is the second child here, after the label.

rules.name: opens the menu and focuses the first enabled item on ArrowDown
rules.source: Dropdown.svelte (toggle, keydown, focusBy, close, outside, focusout, left), menu.ts (menuOpening), roving.ts (menuMove, landOn)

rules.name: opens the menu and focuses the last enabled item on ArrowUp
rules.source: Dropdown.svelte (toggle, keydown, focusBy, close, outside, focusout, left), menu.ts (menuOpening), roving.ts (menuMove, landOn)

rules.name: moves focus to the next enabled item on ArrowDown and wraps from the last to the first
rules.source: Dropdown.svelte (toggle, keydown, focusBy, close, outside, focusout, left), menu.ts (menuOpening), roving.ts (menuMove, landOn)
rules.note: ArrowUp moves to the previous enabled item and wraps from the first to the last; Home and End go to the first and the last. Items that match :disabled or [aria-disabled="true"] are skipped.

rules.name: closes on Escape and returns focus to the trigger
rules.source: Dropdown.svelte (toggle, keydown, focusBy, close, outside, focusout, left), menu.ts (menuOpening), roving.ts (menuMove, landOn)

rules.name: closes when an item is chosen and returns focus to the trigger
rules.source: Dropdown.svelte (toggle, keydown, focusBy, close, outside, focusout, left), menu.ts (menuOpening), roving.ts (menuMove, landOn), DropdownItem.svelte (chosen)
rules.note: The item's own click handler runs first; if it prevents the default action the menu stays open.

rules.name: closes without moving focus when the trigger is clicked again
rules.source: Dropdown.svelte (toggle, keydown, focusBy, close, outside, focusout, left), menu.ts (menuOpening), roving.ts (menuMove, landOn)

rules.name: closes on a press outside, on focus leaving it, and on the window losing focus
rules.source: Dropdown.svelte (toggle, keydown, focusBy, close, outside, focusout, left), menu.ts (menuOpening), roving.ts (menuMove, landOn)
rules.note: The pointerdown target is any node outside .dropdown. A focusout whose relatedTarget is outside .dropdown, and a blur of the window, close it the same way, without moving focus.
